approach: Independent implementation of Salesforce-compatible behavior using public API observations and unmodified clients.
notes: An experimental Salesforce replacement with a tenant-isolated Go/PostgreSQL candidate, Account and Contact APIs, and a localized Vue record workflow. Broader protocol, metadata, security and migration compatibility remains in development. Not production-ready or certified Salesforce-compatible. This is a software compatibility project, not a game recompilation or binary decompilation.
